boundary.source: entooma_sidai_target_area_03.13.2026 shapefile, converted in the existing data room

cell_day_method.status: proposed analytical convention, not native VIIRS pixel identity
cell_day_method.coordinate_transform: pyproj Transformer EPSG:4326→EPSG:32736 with always_xy=True; use detection longitude/latitude point
cell_day_method.zone_assignment: Existing importer point-in-polygon logic first; each observation belongs to project or outside-only ring
cell_day_method.aggregation: Same cell/day detected by multiple satellites or passes counts once per zone; different days count separately. One UTC day counts once per zone for days_with_detection.
cell_day_method.limitations: Grid cells are an analysis convention. Detection-point assignment does not represent the full footprint. Cell-days are neither unique fires, burned cells, burned area nor risk. Do not multiply by cell area.

provenance.coverage_definition: Each month requires every planned chunk for all three satellites, validated response schema and dates. Missing/failed chunk => unavailable (null), not zero.

units.distinct_cell_days: distinct analysis-grid cell × UTC date pairs

fire.density_method: distinct_cell_days * 1000 / (snapshot zone area_ha / 100); areas provisional, not burned area
fire.processing_note: S-NPP and NOAA-20: SP October 2025–June 2026, NRT July–September 2026. NOAA-21: NRT throughout. No SP/NRT overlap within a satellite.
fire.reason: 12 months extracted in both zones; automatic, not reviewed. Detection counts and cell-days are not unique fires, burned area or risk.

disturbance.source: GFW / Global Nature Watch Integrated Disturbance Alerts
disturbance.reason: Versioned, spatially clipped extraction pending. No alerted-area totals are inferred.

vegetation.method: Monthly median of valid observations per pixel, ORBIT mosaicking; spatial statistics by zone
vegetation.coverage_definition: 100 * (sampleCount - noDataCount) / geometryPixelCount; at least one valid observation per monthly pixel
vegetation.reason: 12 months extracted at 250 m, unreviewed, no baseline. Perimeter and ring are provisional.

climate.spatial_support: Single grid-point proxy at boundary centroid; not a project-wide average
climate.reason: Unavailable months stay null. Source latency is distinct from snapshot date.
